name: Creamy Bell Pepper, Jalapeño, Onion & Corn Sauté with Warm Tortillas

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers. Cut into ½-inch thick strips and divide between two baking sheet pans.

Wash, dry, and halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Slice into thin strips and add to the baking sheets with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Drizzle the mixed peppers with oil and season with spices; toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven and roast, tossing halfway, until peppers are soft and begin to brown, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onions into half-moons.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw; set aside to drain.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces.
Add cream cheese, yogurt, cream, and broth to the pot with the onion; cook, stirring frequently, until the sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
355 ml heavy whipping cream
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: When the peppers are done, add them to the pot along with the corn; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide creamy veggie sauté between bowls; serve with warm tortillas on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
